summary: Paris, France, software engineer, strong advocate for free software and privacy, interest in functional programming languages (Haskell, OCaml), critical of centralized internet services, believes in decentralization and personal data ownership, supports the FreedomBox initiative, engaged in discussions about the implications of technology on society, prefers Bépo keyboard layout for French typing, skeptical of mainstream social media platforms, emphasizes the importance of privacy and data security, has a strong interest in mathematics and philosophy, particularly in relation to existence and consciousness.
